verdict.rationale: Greptile's security page says customers can turn off logging to make chats "100% private." Self-hosting keeps logs on customer servers only, a strong route to avoiding vendor-side tracking. However, the same page reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize customer data for analytics and AI training, with no documented opt-out from that carve-out. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out control for the CLI or SaaS, a documented opt-out from de-identified analytics and AI training, coverage beyond chat logging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
